Upon the break of dawn, thou shalt arise and make thy way to the airport, where thy journey to Japan doth begin.


Take thy seat aboard the mighty metal bird, and feel it take to the skies, soaring above the clouds and carrying thee towards a land of ancient customs and new experiences.


After a journey of several hours, thou shalt arrive in the bustling metropolis of Tokyo. Here, thou shalt marvel at the towering skyscrapers and the neon lights that illuminate the cityscape.


On the morrow, venture forth to explore the city's many temples and shrines, where thou shalt pay homage to the gods and goddesses of this ancient land. Wander the hallowed halls of the Meiji Shrine, and feel the weight of history upon thy shoulders.


The following day, make thy way to the historic district of Asakusa, where thou shalt find the Senso-ji Temple. Here, thou shalt light a candle and offer up a prayer, seeking the blessings of the gods.


In the evening, take a stroll along the Sumida River, where thou shalt find solace in the gentle breeze and the peaceful waters. Marvel at the beauty of the Tokyo Skytree, and feel a sense of awe at the modern marvels that surround thee.

On the fourth day of thy journey, venture forth to the city of Kyoto. Here, thou shalt find yourself in the midst of a city that is a living testament to the past. Wander the streets of Gion, and feel as though thou hast stepped back in time.


On the fifth day, make thy way to the Fushimi Inari Shrine, where thou shalt find yourself surrounded by thousands of vermilion torii gates. Climb the mountain path, and feel the spirit of the ancient gods guiding thee.


On the sixth day, venture forth to the historic city of Nara. Here, thou shalt find yourself in the midst of a city that is a living testament to the past. Wander the streets of Nara Park, and feel as though thou hast stepped back in time.


On the seventh day, make thy way to the Kinkaku-ji Temple, where thou shalt find thyself in the presence of a golden pavilion that shines like a beacon of hope and light.


On the eighth day, venture forth to the historic city of Hiroshima. Here, thou shalt find thyself in a city that has risen from the ashes, a testament to the resilience of the human spirit. Wander the streets of the Peace Memorial Park, and feel the weight of history upon thy shoulders.


On the ninth day, make thy way to the Miyajima Island, where thou shalt find thyself in the midst of a natural paradise. Wander the streets of the Itsukushima Shrine, and feel as though thou hast stepped back in time.


On the tenth day, venture forth to the city of Osaka. Here, thou shalt find thyself in a city that is a vibrant blend of the old and the new. Wander the streets of Dotonbori, and feel the energy of the city coursing through thy veins.


On the eleventh day, make thy way to the Osaka Castle, where thou shalt find thyself in the presence of a mighty fortress that stands as a testament to the power and grandeur of the past.


On the twelfth day, venture forth to the historic city of Kanazawa. Here, thou shalt find thyself in a city that is a living testament to the past. Wander the streets of the Higashi Chaya District, and feel as though thou hast stepped back in time.


On the thirteenth day, make thy way to the Kenrokuen Garden, where thou shalt find thyself in the midst of a natural paradise. Wander the paths of the garden, and feel the beauty of the natural world surround thee.


On the fourteenth day, venture forth to the city of Nagano. Here, thou shalt find thyself in a city that is a vibrant blend of the old and the new. Wander the streets of the Zenkoji Temple, and feel the energy of the city coursing through thy veins.


On the fifteenth day, make thy way to the Jigokudani Monkey Park, where thou shalt find thyself in the midst of a natural paradise. Wander the paths of the park, and feel the beauty of the natural world surround thee.


On the sixteenth day, venture forth to the historic city of Nikko. Here, thou shalt find thyself in a city that is a living testament to the past. Wander the streets of the Toshogu Shrine, and feel as though thou hast stepped back in time.


On the seventeenth day, make thy way to the Lake Chuzenji, where thou shalt find thyself in the midst of a natural paradise. Wander the paths of the lake, and feel the beauty of the natural world surround thee.


On the eighteenth day, venture forth to the city of Sendai. Here, thou shalt find thyself in a city that is a vibrant blend of the old and the new. Wander the streets of the Zuihoden Mausoleum, and feel the energy of the city coursing through thy veins.


On the nineteenth day, make thy way to the Matsushima Bay, where thou shalt find thyself in the midst of a natural paradise. Wander the paths of the bay, and feel the beauty of the natural world surround thee.


On the twentieth day, venture forth to the historic city of Hakodate. Here, thou shalt find thyself in a city that is a living testament to the past. Wander the streets of the Goryokaku Fort, and feel as though thou hast stepped back in time.


On the twenty-first day, make thy way to the Mount Hakodate, where thou shalt find thyself in the midst of a natural paradise. Wander the paths of the mountain, and feel the beauty of the natural world surround thee.


On the twenty-second day, venture forth to the city of Sapporo. Here, thou shalt find thyself in a city that is a vibrant blend of the old and the new. Wander the streets of the Odori Park, and feel the energy of the city coursing through thy veins.


On the twenty-third day, make thy way to the Sapporo Beer Museum, where thou shalt find thyself in the midst of a celebration of the city's proud brewing tradition.


On the twenty-fourth day, venture forth to the historic city of Otaru. Here, thou shalt find thyself in a city that is a living testament to the past. Wander the streets of the Otaru Canal, and feel as though thou hast stepped back in time.

On the twenty-sixth day, venture forth to the city of Noboribetsu. Here, thou shalt find thyself in a city that is a vibrant blend of the old and the new. Wander the streets of the Noboribetsu Date Jidaimura, and feel the energy of the city coursing through thy veins.


On the twenty-seventh day, make thy way to the Noboribetsu Hell Valley, where thou shalt find thyself in the midst of a natural wonder. Wander the paths of the valley, and feel the beauty of the natural world surround thee.


On the twenty-eighth day, venture forth to the city of Muroran. Here, thou shalt find thyself in a city that is a vibrant blend of the old and the new. Wander the streets of the Cape Chikyu, and feel the energy of the city coursing through thy veins.


On the twenty-ninth day, make thy way to the Shikotsu-Toya National Park, where thou shalt find thyself in the midst of a natural paradise. Wander the paths of the park, and feel the beauty of the natural world surround thee.


On the thirtieth day, thou shalt make thy way back to Tokyo, where thou shalt prepare for thy journey home. On the morrow, thou shalt arise and make thy way to the airport, where thou shalt board the mighty metal bird and soar once more above the clouds.


And so, thou shalt return home, with a heart full of memories and a soul enriched by the beauty and wonder of the land of the rising sun. Fare thee well, and may the winds of fortune ever be at thy back.
